note: Drive about 6.3 miles up Icicle Creek Road and park on the south side of the road, about 200 yards before the base of Icicle Buttress. A trail starts by a large boulder on the roadbank; first crags are ~15 minutes up.
basis: MP Duty Dome area Getting There: 'Drive west up Icicle Creek ~6.3 miles. Park on the south side of the road and look for a trail heading up about 200 yards before the base of Icicle Buttress. A large boulder on the roadbank helps identify the start of the trail.'

note: Park in the large pullout on the right (uphill side) of the Alpine Loop road, about 0.65 mi past the Hideaway parking and marked by the green mile marker 11 sign. Cross the road for the trail. It is a National Forest fee area.
basis: MP Hell Area Getting There: 'pass the Hideaway parking on the left... large pullout on the right... green mile marker 11 sign. Park here, walk back the way you came, and cross the road.' Access: 'Located in a National Forest Fee Area.'

note: Drive 0.8 mi up Maple Canyon Road from the canyon mouth, where the pavement turns to dirt, and park at one of several roadside pullouts. The land is private; a small donation for parking is requested.
basis: MP Box Canyon: 'Drive .8 miles from the mouth of Maple Canyon where the paved road turns to dirt road and park at one of several pullouts.' Access notice asks donation of $8/night, $3/day with donation boxes.
